customManagers.description: Track tool versions pinned via `go install <module>/cmd/...@vX` in workflow run steps (e.g. deadcode), which no built-in manager parses. Needed so the go-toolchain group can keep deadcode in lockstep with the Go release.

packageRules.description: Bump all OpenTelemetry Go modules together. Their schema/semconv versions are coupled, so a piecemeal bump leaves the SDK and the app's semconv import on mismatched schema URLs and breaks resource.Merge.

Keep the Go toolchain and everything version-locked to it in one PR: the language version (go.mod directive + setup-go), the golang Docker image, golangci-lint, and the x/tools analyzers (deadcode). A Go bump that outpaces the tooling breaks CI — deadcode's SSA builder panics on new syntax and golangci-lint hits typecheck errors on the new stdlib. Grouping forces CI to validate the whole set together instead of merging them piecemeal.
